# Feature Request Template

Structured template for proposing new product capabilities: problem statement, proposed solution, acceptance criteria, user value, and priority. Companion resources for the [Feature Request Template](https://stackpractices.com/docs/feature-request-template/) article.

## Files

| File | Description |
|------|-------------|
| `feature-request-template.md` | Blank, copy-paste-ready Markdown template |
| `filled-example-csv-export.md` | Filled example: CSV export request with quantified pain and testable criteria |
| `github-issue-form.yml` | GitHub issue form (`.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/feature_request.yml`) with required fields and pain-level dropdown |

## Usage

Copy `feature-request-template.md` into your issue tracker, wiki, or docs folder. For GitHub, commit `github-issue-form.yml` to `.github/ISSUE_TEMPLATE/` and the form appears under **New Issue**.
